changes.title: Arkansas and New Mexico withdrawn to U
changes.summary: Arkansas and New Mexico publish their rules only on hosts that show a human-verification (CAPTCHA) page. The 1.0.0 read reached the text by sending a browser user agent past that block, which our method does not allow, so both states are now U (blank) until a read that passes no challenge. No other record changed.

changes.title: First release
changes.summary: Fee-division (Rule 1.5(e) or its equivalent) and referral-payment (Rule 7.2(b) or its equivalent) rules for every state and DC, each read at the official source on 2026-10-27, with quotes. Unverified cells are left blank and marked U.
